problem_context.problem_statement: 重新验证 CRTOS 循环缓冲区 CircularAreaInit。函数名、static 属性、签名和函数体必须与 CRTOS circular_area.c 对齐，包括两个分配失败分支中的 active KPrintf；ERROR 宏按 CRTOS 为 1。只修 annotation/spec/证明，不改变算法；函数 spec 直接使用参数名，不对参数使用 @pre。完成 canonical symbolic execution、全部 manual VC、fixed goal_check、final-check 和独立 freshness。
problem_context.expected_behavior: 对合法长度分配并初始化 CircularArea 与 data buffer，设置 p_head=data_buffer、p_tail=data_buffer+area_length、索引和状态为 0、operations 指针；任一分配失败时按 CRTOS 清理并打印错误，返回 NULL。
problem_context.input_output_contract: 输入 area_length 和 operations/allocator/global string resources；输出 NULL 或拥有完整已初始化 descriptor/buffer 的 CircularArea 指针；资源和失败清理符合 CRTOS。
spec_hint: 保留原始 malloc/free/memset/KPrintf 调用；用 GlobalStrings/LitMap 保护两条日志；有效成功状态 0<area_length<=256，p_tail one-past-end。

annotation_contract.ready_condition: agent_result.annotation.status == completed and ready_for_annotation_check_round == true only after canonical QCP, case_lib coqc, and annotation-checking pass; self_reworkable_failures must be empty
annotation_contract.blocked_condition: only phase skill hard blockers should use status == blocked; self_repair_budget_exhausted is work evidence, not an automatic blocked condition

mathematical_postconditions_required: Function specs must state what result the function computes, not only bounds or shape facts.
Loop invariants must connect processed state to the final mathematical postcondition.
avoid_spec_antipatterns: Do not weaken the spec to shape-only or bounds-only conditions.
Do not restate the C loops as the mathematical definition.
